lendable.title: Senior Product Designer
lendable.description:
About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot )
So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.
We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.
Join us if you want to
Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions
Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting
We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable (Lendable). You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design.
You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.
The ideal candidate
5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup
Strong mobile app and web experience
Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence
Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right
Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk
AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster
Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback
Bonus:
Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override)
Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools
Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty
UX writing
What you'll be doing
Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction
Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build
Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions
Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer
Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success
Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself
Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work
Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own
Our design principles
Simplicity wins
If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless.
Evidence over ego
We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined based on real user behavior.
Trust is our best feature
Finance is built on trust. Every design decision should reinforce transparency, security, and user confidence. We prove we care by helping users make financial decisions that empower them.
Interview Process
CV screening
An introductory call with someone from the Talent Team and/or hiring manager
A take-home exercise to complete in your own time
Task debrief with members of the design team (45 mins)
Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):
VP Product & Design
Engineering team members
Final round interview with our CPO
Life at Lendable
Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover
Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations
Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.
Check out our blog !

ladders.title: Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph | NASA | Remote
ladders.description:
At Ladders , we’re building the most effective AI products in job search. We are at the forefront of using AI to get our users more interviews.
As the leading innovator in our space, we’re shipping industry-first and industry-best products:
• The first AI-generated resumes
• One-click resume customization for every job
• Instant, personalized cover letters that feel human
• LinkedIn profile optimization that drives responses
• With more great innovations to come - built by you!
Every week, we ship products that help people advance their careers — faster, smarter, and with less friction. Our products help professionals stand out, get seen, and land interviews that lead to better careers.
We work in tight, high-output teams that care deeply about craft, clarity, and customer outcomes.
If you’re excited to build ambitious, high-leverage tools with a team that moves fast and ships often — we’d love to meet you.
We’re looking for an end-to-end product designer to bring the voices of our users to the table and work collaboratively with engineers to achieve business goals. You should be comfortable with user research, visual UI design, and designing complex UX flows.
Responsibilities:
Plan and execute user research, low-fi ideation, high-fi designs, and prototypes
Contribute to high-level product decisions and execute on product roadmap features
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to assess constraints, de-risk solutions, and provide support during implementation
Consider how design impacts user behavior and metrics/analytics
Present design work and research findings to key stakeholders, with an emphasis on simplicity, intuitive designs and an iterative approach
Deliver customer facing and internal web-platforms as well as emails, mobile apps and browser extensions
Work with cross-functional partners to help define the roadmap within your product area
Facilitate and participate in product review and product brainstorms
Receive and provide feedback on designs and strategic product decisions
Develop and maintain detailed design documentation including specifications, redlines, and style guides
Use metrics to analyze and continuously improve the user experience
Requirements:
Proven experience in conducting qualitative and quantitative research, including A/B testing best practices, surveys, usability tests, and user interviews.
Experience translating research findings into strategic narratives
Highly proficient with industry-standard tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Dovetail, etc.)
7+ years of experience working in UX/UI/product design
A top-notch design portfolio demonstrating process, outcomes, and impact is a plus - particularly in shipped, successful products
Experience designing for a responsive mobile and desktop web experience
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Excited about working in a fast-paced, agile startup environment

keen.title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
keen.description:
About us Keen is an AI-native hiring platform for hospitality. Our applicant tracking system screens and pre-qualifies candidates so hiring teams can focus on people, not admin. Alongside it we run an established hospitality job board, with a large candidate community and hundreds of employer clients, that we are turning into a talent marketplace. Our line sums up how we design: Attention belongs to people. We are a startup team with real scale behind us, based in Barcelona and working across Europe.
The role You will lead design across two products. The first is a full overhaul of our existing job board, which we are turning into a two-sided talent marketplace for candidates and employers. The second is the Keen ATS, where you will lead the next wave of AI-native features. You sit where product, self-serve growth, marketing and engineering meet.
What you'll do Lead the job board to marketplace overhaul. Audit what exists, set the direction, and redesign the candidate and employer journeys with engineering: discovery, matching, applying and hiring.
Lead innovation in the Keen ATS. Design new features, from AI pre-screening and candidate pipelines to agentic workflows that plug into a hotel's existing ATS.
Own one design system (tokens, components, patterns) shared by the marketplace and the ATS, so engineering ships faster and both feel like one product family.
Drive self-serve growth with our Head of Self-Serve Growth and CMO. Design and test sign-up, onboarding, checkout and upgrade flows against activation and conversion data.
Work hand in hand with marketing on landing pages, campaign assets and the Keen brand in product, so brand and product read as one experience.
Run lean research. Talk to hotel recruiters and candidates, run usability tests, read the analytics, and turn findings into decisions within days.
What you bring Must have: job board or marketplace experience. You have designed for a job board, recruitment marketplace or other two-sided marketplace, and know how supply, demand and matching shape the experience.
Must have: ATS background. You have designed applicant tracking or recruiting software and understand the hiring flow end to end: job posting, sourcing, screening, interviews and offer.
5+ years designing digital products across UI and UX, including redesigning an existing product at scale, with a portfolio of shipped work and the results it drove.
Product-led growth instincts: you have designed onboarding, pricing and checkout flows and measured them with A/B tests and funnel data.
A current craft: AI-native interfaces (agent workflows, explainable recommendations, human-in-the-loop review), mobile-first and responsive design, WCAG 2.2 accessibility, motion and micro-interactions.
Expert in Figma and design systems; you prototype quickly with AI-assisted and code-based tools and speak components and constraints with developers.
A startup mindset: you own outcomes, handle ambiguity, and move from strategy to pixels in the same day.
Fluent English and a sharp ear for UX copy.
Nice to have B2B SaaS experience.
A background in hospitality.
Hands-on Webflow (or similar) for marketing sites.
Spanish or another European language.
What we offer Real ownership: you set the design direction for two products used by millions of candidates and hundreds of employers.
A short line to the CEO, CMO and CTO; small team, fast decisions, no committees.
Competitive compensation.
Full-time; employment or freelance contract.
Based at our Barcelona office (Sant Gervasi), or remote within Europe with regular time in Barcelona.
How to apply: send your portfolio through our LinkedIn post, with a short note on one redesign you are proud of: what you changed and what it moved.

salve.title: Senior Product Designer (AI & Consumer Experiences)
salve.description:
About The Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to join the fully remote R&D team of a fast-growing international AI technology company. In this hands-on position, you will take ownership of end-to-end product design across a large-scale consumer platform, creating engaging, intuitive and visually polished digital experiences. Your work will cover conversational interfaces, character creation, subscription and monetisation journeys, growth features and emerging AI-powered interactions.
Working closely with the Design Lead, Product Managers and founders, you will combine strategic product thinking with exceptional visual execution to deliver innovative, mobile-first experiences. This opportunity is ideal for a highly autonomous designer who thrives in fast-paced product environments, embraces AI-powered design workflows and enjoys shaping new interaction models from concept through to launch.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end product design across conversational experiences, character creation, monetisation journeys and user growth features.
Design innovative product experiences involving live interactions, interactive features and AI-generated video.
Collaborate closely with the Design Lead, Product Managers and founders to define product direction and translate business objectives into compelling user experiences.
Take ownership of assigned product areas, independently driving design initiatives from initial concept through to final implementation.
Translate strategic product requirements into high-quality user interfaces, interaction patterns and visual designs.
Create engaging, intuitive and scalable mobile-first experiences for a large international consumer audience.
Develop polished UI designs, interactive prototypes, user flows and detailed design specifications.
Contribute to the complete product design lifecycle, including ideation, exploration, prototyping, iteration and delivery.
Apply modern design principles to improve usability, engagement, conversion and overall product experience.
Use AI-powered tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, content generation and creative experimentation.
Work with cross-functional product and engineering teams to ensure accurate implementation of design solutions.
Explore emerging interaction models and contribute to the evolution of AI-powered consumer experiences.
Maintain high standards of visual consistency, interaction quality and design craftsmanship.
Adapt quickly to changing product priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-moving environment.
Requirements
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in end-to-end consumer product design.
Proven experience designing and launching mobile-first digital products at scale.
Strong strategic product thinking combined with exceptional visual and interaction design skills.
Outstanding portfolio demonstrating polished, modern and high-quality user interfaces across real consumer products.
Ability to demonstrate excellent visual craftsmanship, attention to detail and design quality through previous work.
Advanced proficiency in Figma.
Strong prototyping capabilities using design tools and/or code-based approaches.
Practical experience using AI tools daily for design, prototyping, creative exploration or content generation.
Ability to clearly explain the AI tools, techniques and workflows used throughout the design process.
Experience independently managing product design initiatives and taking ownership of complete product areas.
Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, user experience, interaction design and consumer product behaviour.
Ability to translate complex product requirements into intuitive and engaging user experiences.
Excellent asynchronous communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams.
Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-paced international environment.
Willingness to work initially on a B2B or contractor basis.
Experience with subscription-based products, monetisation journeys or conversion optimisation is an advantage.
Knowledge of gamification principles and engagement mechanics is an advantage.
Experience with motion design, 3D design or illustration is an advantage.
Front-end development knowledge, including HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is an advantage.
Benefits
Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level product design experience.
Fully remote working arrangement from anywhere in Europe.
Initial B2B or contractor engagement with potential transition to full-time employment.
4 weeks of paid time off annually.
Health and wellbeing allowance.
Dedicated learning and professional development budget.
Access to premium AI tools and design technologies.
High-autonomy environment with significant ownership over product design decisions.
Direct collaboration with senior design leadership, Product Managers and company founders.
Opportunity to shape innovative AI-powered consumer products used by a large international audience.
Exposure to emerging technologies, interactive experiences and new design approaches.
Professional growth and career development opportunities within an expanding international technology organisation.
Supportive environment that encourages experimentation, creativity and continuous learning.
Additional employee benefits and development opportunities.
